stories.headline: Trumbull soccer falls 3–2 to undefeated Stamford; Simsbury next Sunday
stories.summary: Trumbull’s Eagles dropped a 3–2 decision to ranked Stamford in a top-of-the-state clash, ending a stretch that had slipped to 0-2-1 since a three-game winning streak and moving the team to 5-3-1. Stamford improved to 6-0 and extended an eight-game home winning streak dating to last season. Both sides hit the road Sunday — Trumbull at Simsbury at 1:30 p.m., Stamford at South Windsor at 3:20 p.m.

stories.headline: Trump says he approved new fuel economy rules to end Biden EV pressure
stories.summary: President Trump posted Saturday that he has approved new fuel economy standards ending what he called the Biden-era electric-vehicle mandate, arguing Democrats forced unwanted cars and wasted billions on chargers that were never built. He said the reset will lower new-car prices, invites GM, Ford, and Stellantis to build more in America, and credits Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Ford CEO Jim Farley previously hailed a similar CAFE reset as a win for affordability; Trump also ended EV tax credits in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

stories.headline: Homan: ICE can break Obama’s 409,000 deportation record next year
stories.summary: Border czar Tom Homan told The Epoch Times on Saturday that ICE arrests should climb further next year as thousands of newly trained agents enter the field, after three straight monthly records capped by 50,925 arrests in August. He separated arrest totals from removals — saying September already produced the highest single-month deportation count — and predicted the administration can surpass Barack Obama’s 409,000 fiscal-year removal record. The White House cites more than 605,000 deportations since Trump returned to office, while Homan notes ICE is still setting records despite more than 100 nationwide injunctions.

stories.headline: DHS: ICE has deported more than 2,000 known or suspected terrorists
stories.summary: Ahead of the 25th anniversary of 9/11, DHS said ICE arrested more than 2,150 known or suspected terrorists and deported 2,015 of them between Jan. 20, 2025 and Sept. 9, 2026. Secretary Markwayne Mullin framed the removals as “never forget” vigilance, citing cases that include a Mexico national charged as ringleader of a failed UFC Freedom 250 plot who had received DACA, a Brazilian PCC/CV commander arrested in North Carolina, and four Tren de Aragua members who pleaded guilty in a Bronx double murder after Biden-era releases.

stories.headline: Musk: Grok trails Anthropic for now; Grok Bot growing ~100% a month
stories.summary: In a China Media Group interview, Elon Musk called Grok 4.7 a “solid workhorse” that still lags Anthropic’s latest Opus-class models, blaming xAI’s shorter three-year head start versus Anthropic’s six and saying he expects to catch the frontier sometime next year. He said agentic Grok Bot — framed as a personal digital assistant — is growing about 100% month over month, and argued SpaceX and Tesla engineering data can push Grok past software-only rivals into real-world engineering AI. Musk also estimated China could close lithography and chipmaking gaps in roughly two to three years.

stories.headline: Penguins close preseason 3–1 in Buffalo; Rust exits, Silovs rebounds
stories.summary: Pittsburgh beat Buffalo 3–1 in Saturday’s preseason finale as Sidney Crosby opened with a vintage slap shot, Ville Koivunen scored off a Bryan Rust feed, and Nick Robertson sealed it with an empty-netter beside Rickard Rakell — after two other Penguins goals were wiped by coach’s challenges. Rust left in the second period with no update from coach Dan Muse, testing a forward depth already thinned in camp. Arturs Silovs bounced back from a rough Detroit outing with a strong finish; the club practices Sunday before the 23-man roster is due Monday at 5 p.m.

stories.headline: Jets–Lions Sunday: Glenn’s return, No. 1 defense vs. 31st, 1 p.m. FOX
stories.summary: Both clubs sit 1–1 heading into Sunday’s 1 p.m. ET FOX kickoff at Ford Field, where Jets coach Aaron Glenn faces the Lions offense he coordinated against as Detroit’s defensive coordinator from 2021–24. Dan Campbell said he has “tremendous” respect for Glenn and a clear read on New York’s style after Buffalo lit up Detroit 41–31 on Thursday Night Football. Jared Goff threw four touchdowns in that loss while Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs kept stacking dual scores; Lions.com notes fans can stream the local FOX feed free on phones via the club site and app.

stories.headline: watchOS 27.0.1 patches unexpected restarts on Series 12 and Ultra 4
stories.summary: Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 limited to Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, with release notes saying it fixes bugs including unexpected restarts that owners reported while editing faces, using Siri AI, Maps, workouts, and even idle. The update installs from the watch Settings app or the iPhone Watch app only when the watch is on the charger above 50% battery. It arrives about a week after watchOS 27’s public launch brought Siri AI and other system changes to the new hardware.

stories.headline: Amon Amarth’s The Allfather Awakens lands Oct. 2 with new Golden Hall stage
stories.summary: Johan Hegg told Germany’s Rock Antenne the band is anxious to share The Allfather Awakens, due Oct. 2 on Metal Blade, after writing only the songs they meant to keep and shelving one unfinished cut for the first time. Producer Jacob Hansen tracked the 13th album across two Denmark sessions ending March 2026, with a less-modern Marshall guitar tone and Odin-centric lyrics that are not a full concept album. Fall shows will unveil a new Golden Hall–inspired production as the North American tour with Dethklok and Castle Rat builds pre-release buzz.

stories.headline: Jeep recalls ~202,000 SUVs after TPMS software goes silent on low tires
stories.summary: Stellantis filed NHTSA campaign 26V559 covering 201,976 Jeep and Wagoneer SUVs from the 2024–2026 model years after Valeo Radio Frequency Hub software can lose reference pressures and never light the low-tire warning. The recall spans Grand Cherokee, Grand Cherokee L, Wagoneer, Grand Wagoneer, and related PHEVs; NHTSA warns a silent TPMS can cause a crash without prior warning and violates FMVSS 138. The free fix is a dealer reflash — no parts — with owner letters phased Sept. 29–Oct. 21; until then Stellantis says check tires with a gauge.

stories.headline: LEGO Jurassic Park Jeep Wrangler 77984: 1,924-piece 1:10 display icon
stories.summary: LEGO’s 18+ Jurassic Park Jeep Wrangler (77984) rebuilds the modified 1992 Sahara at 1:10 scale with 1,924 pieces, functional rear-spare steering, liftable hood, and modular canvas/roll-bar setups that echo Jeeps #18/#29, Nedry’s #12 escape, and the T. rex chase. A Dennis Nedry minifigure arrives with the shaving-cream embryo canister and island map, plus the classic “objects in mirror” T. rex sticker. Reviewers flag the winch and windshield as fiddly but praise the set as a display-first AFOL tribute that bridges Jeep and Jurassic collectors.

stories.headline: Musk: Cybercab expanding beyond Texas; Optimus could hit a billion robots
stories.summary: In the same China Media Group interview, Elon Musk said Cybercab is already operating commercially in Texas and will soon expand to Arizona, Nevada, and several other states, with broader commercial coverage targeted by mid-next year. He also projected Optimus could scale to at least one billion humanoid robots in less than a decade as Tesla pairs manufacturing with AI and robotics. Musk separately praised Tesla Shanghai’s Chinese team as the “magic” behind a factory he called “a gem,” while noting China’s AI models deliver strong performance per unit of compute.
